dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, crenulated perimeters. Light-colored rings show sharp transitions from the dark exterior pelt to high-intensity pixel bands, surrounding dark internal cores. These structures are most defined in the central mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid light-pixel clusters localized near the ventral-lateral margins. These clusters lack internal gradients or dark centers, appearing as solid, irregular high-intensity points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form a jagged, irregular quadrilateral. The geometric relationship is defined by unequal side lengths and sharp interior angles, particularly between the mid-dorsal and posterior clusters.
